entry.title: ProstoCAD 0.16.1: Bug fixes
entry.content:
Fixed

  • An open section follows changes to the part: new material no longer shows as a hole in the cut.
  • End of Part stays where you move it, above or below a Boolean.
  • A feature made outside its dialog (a FreeCAD file, an AI's script) opens with its own values, not the defaults.
  • With End of Part moved up, feature dialogs no longer recompute the steps below it.
